extracted.name: Cricket Madeleines
extracted.description: Delicious madeleines made with an eco-friendly protein alternative that has a lower environmental impact.
instruction_lines: Whisk egg and sugar until light and fluffy.
Mix flour, cricket powder, baking powder, and salt separately.
Fold dry ingredients into wet ingredients.
Bake for 8–10 minutes until lightly golden.
